conversation.speaker: dialogue
conversation.text:
Police: Is Xiyuan okay now?
Respondent: She said she had a great time playing at Auntie’s home.
Respondent: Later, she told Auntie that she missed her dad, so she was sent back...
Respondent: I’m truly sorry. I should have contacted you earlier.
Respondent: I was only thinking about myself... even though I knew you were still looking for the child...
Respondent: That person returned the child three days after Xiyuan went missing, but I didn’t ask anything.
Respondent: You may find it strange when I say this, but... other than thanking him, I didn’t know what else to say.
Respondent: Even if you asked me to kowtow a hundred times... I would do it without hesitation.
Respondent: As long as Xiyuan came back safe and sound...
Respondent: I think that’s enough.
Respondent: Xiyuan...
Respondent: has suffered a lot since she was little...
Respondent: Yet I let her be hurt once again... I am an incompetent father.
Respondent: That person...
Respondent: Did he turn himself in?
